PadelGo – Terms & Conditions
 Last updated: 15 August 2025

 1. Eligibility


You must be at least 18 years old to create an account.

You must provide accurate and complete registration details.

You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure.


2. Account Registration


By registering, you consent to PadelGo processing your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

You agree not to create multiple accounts for the purpose of misusing promotions, discounts, or offers.


3. Payments & Fees


All payments are processed via Stripe or other approved payment gateways.

Rental fees are charged before ride start. Additional charges may apply for late returns or damages.

All prices are shown in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR) unless otherwise stated.

Payments are non-refundable except where required by law or explicitly approved by PadelGo.


4. Ride Rules


You may only start a ride after your payment is confirmed and a station officer releases your bike.

You must follow traffic laws and safety guidelines during your ride.

The bike must be returned to the designated PadelGo station in good condition.

You are responsible for any damages, theft, or loss of the bike during your rental period.


5. User Responsibilities


Ensure the bike is safe and functional before starting your ride.

Do not share your account or allow others to ride on your booking.

Do not use the bike for illegal activities or off-road riding.


6. Liability & Disclaimers


PadelGo is not responsible for any injuries, damages, or losses arising from your use of the bike or Services.

You ride at your own risk.

We provide the Services “as is” and make no warranties about uninterrupted or error-free operation.


7. Suspension & Termination


We may suspend or terminate your account if you breach these Terms, damage property, or engage in unsafe or unlawful activities.


8. Changes to Terms


PadelGo may update these Terms at any time. We will notify you through the app or email.

Continued use of the Services after changes take effect means you accept the updated Terms.


9. Governing Law


These Terms are governed by the laws of Sri Lanka.

Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Sri Lanka.


By registering, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms & Conditions.

PadelGo is a modern bicycle rental platform designed to make eco-friendly travel simple, affordable, and fun. With just a few taps, you can book, pay, and ride — all through our mobile app.


Our mission is to reduce traffic congestion and carbon emissions while giving people a healthy, convenient way to get around.


PadelGo partners with trusted station officers who ensure every bike is safe, clean, and ready for your journey.


Whether you’re commuting, exercising, or exploring, PadelGo is here to make your ride easy and enjoyable.
